card.name: The word every in dosing intervals
card.fires_on: The word "every" (or the space or digit right after it) when it starts a repeat interval, such as "once every other day" or "one drop every 4 hours". Also fires on the same spot in "every 69 seconds".

modes.label: Every in dose schedules
modes.description: "every" after once or one drop, giving the spacing between doses.
modes.example: the regimen should be adjusted to 0.3 mg once<< every>> other day.

modes.label: Every in event-rate statements
modes.description: The gap or first digit after "every" in a statistic about how often something happens.
modes.example: An American develops Alzheimer’s every<< >>69 seconds.

card.plain: It lights up on the word "every" when text says how often something is done or happens.
